patterns.what_worked: Re-verifying the bars-lane filing against the source before editing found that main.lua's alias made its output ALREADY chat output (the identifier was the trap, not the mechanism) while config_presets.lua was a genuine bare global - two different defects needing the same fix shape. Copying the bars-lane pin shape (source scan + alias pin + global-print spy + chat-frame report) gave 8 checks that killed 7/7 mutants, each for the named reason.
patterns.what_was_hard: The st.debug-gated trailers are unreachable by default, so a runtime pin would have been vacuous without flipping the switch in the sandbox - and flipping it inside the shared options_load_state loader would have pulled config.lua (a sibling lane's file, still on the old path) into this lane's verdict, so a dedicated sandbox was needed. The tree was also moving under the lane (concurrent lane added a harness step and 2 files mid-run), so validation numbers had to be re-taken from the final tree and the mutation base rebuilt.
patterns.skill_gap: Building a mutation base copy that excluded bench/ produced a false hunter_state failure that looked like a mutant casualty; the base itself has to be proven green before its mutants mean anything.
